description: A perforated black metal base plate sits on the table with a small upright bracket in the center and an L-shaped Allen key lying in front. The right hand picks up the Allen key, reaches to the bracket’s screw points, and twists the key to loosen the fasteners, then pulls the key away as a screw drops onto the tabletop; the right hand continues turning from different angles and finally lifts the bracket up and off the base plate while the left hand stays resting nearby.
